d:
Ever wondered class ka jo "shaant baccha" hota hai na, what happens when they grow up? This isn't just gussa, it's about hamesha calm, understanding aur forgiving rehne ka weight in a world that mistakes silence for strength.
In this deeply personal monologue, Ankush explores us insaan ka paradox who always "gets it" – the one jo cab drivers ko maaf karta hai, difficult friends ko, aur even childhood bullies ko bhi. But kya hota hai when understanding everyone becomes a burden? When "bigger person" banna feels like burying yourself?
